title: ObligationIR (base v1)
description: Base obligation: a gateable or structural commitment in the orchestration. Logical id 'obligation.ir/v1'. The kind system is from AGENTPLANE_COMPOSITION_PRIMITIVES_SPEC §6; the §13.1 v2 delta adds the task 'graph' and resource 'taint' fields additively. SP_TRACE_CFR_001 binds GOV-SC-DETACH to kind∈{prohibition,resource} and GOV-IRRED capability-class escalation to resource taint.

kind.description: goal=verify-at-completion; prohibition=must-not, continuous; softgoal=advisory, never gates; task=decomposition; resource=capability grant

gateable.description: goal/prohibition true; softgoal MUST be false; task/resource structural

verifier_ref.description: VerifierIR that decides a goal/prohibition; null for softgoal/task/resource
